construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version (integer 1), config, tickets; unknown fields rejected
shared_schema.config: categories: unique nonblank strings; teams: nonblank team-to-accountable-owner mapping; rules: ordered rules; default: decision
shared_schema.rule: id: unique string; keywords: nonempty unique strings; optional channels: nonempty unique exact-match strings; decision
shared_schema.ticket: unique nonblank id, nonblank subject and channel, string body (may be empty)
shared_schema.decision: category from configured categories, priority in low/normal/high/urgent, team from configured teams
shared_schema.success_output: schema_version=1, status=ok, ordered assignments, summary with total/by_priority/by_team
shared_schema.assignment: ticket_id, category, priority, team, accountable_owner, source, nullable rule_id, matched_keywords
shared_schema.error_output: status=error, error message; CLI exit code 2
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function for input and all rule/default/injected decisions; strict JSON rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite constants

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated stage: validated tickets/config -> first matching rule or injected/default decision -> validated decision with accountable owner -> JSON report

behavior.matching: Casefolded substring match against subject and body; any keyword matches; optional channel filter uses exact case-sensitive membership
behavior.precedence: First matching rule wins, independent of priority severity; no rule match uses injected callable if supplied, otherwise configured default
behavior.accountability: Every team must map to one nonblank accountable owner; owner derives only from validated configuration
behavior.optional_ai_seam: triage(payload, classifier=None); local callable receives ticket copy and returns validated decision, tested with synthetic fixtures only; callable failures abort the batch
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clocks or generated IDs; preserves ticket order; injected callable determinism is caller responsibility
behavior.atomicity: Invalid input or decisions abort the batch without partial output
behavior.synthetic_data: All example ticket content and owner identities are explicitly synthetic

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status ok and three accountable assignments
